featured_reviews.name: meena adurty
featured_reviews.review_text:
Assam, Meghalaya & Arunachal Pradesh with Prabhu Travels Mumbai (11N/12D) 2nd April  to 13th April
⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ (5/5)
We recently completed an unforgettable 11-night/12-days Budget tour of Assam, Meghalaya, and Arunachal Pradesh, beautifully arranged by Prabhu Travels Mumbai, and I must say — it was one of the most seamless and enriching travel experiences we've had!
Planning & Coordination:
From the very beginning, Prabhu Travels was highly responsive and attentive to our preferences. They curated a well-paced itinerary that gave us a perfect blend of nature, culture, history, and adventure. Communication was smooth, and all our queries were promptly answered, which gave us a lot of confidence before the trip began
•	Destinations Covered:
•	Assam: We started our journey in Guwahati with a visit to the famous Kamakhya  Temple.
•	 Kaziranga National park  is famous for its population of one-horned rhinoceroses—the highest in the world..
•	Arunachal Pradesh: This was the crown jewel of the trip! We visited Dirang, Tawang, and had the surreal experience of visiting Bumla Pass, right at the Indo-China border — a moment we’ll never forget. We also explored the beautiful Tawang Monastery, Sela Pass, Jung water fall  and Jaswant Singh War Memorial /Temple,
•	Bumla Pass Permit was perfectly arranged in advance, so we didn’t have to worry about any paperwork or delays. The snow-covered landscapes and meeting Indian Army personnel at the border was truly a once-in-a-lifetime experience
•	Meghalaya: Cherrapunjee, Shillong, and Dawki were absolutely stunning and the living root bridges in Mawlynnong were true highlights
•	Indo-Bangla Border (Dawki area): We even got a chance to see the friendly Indo-Bangladesh border in Dawki, with local boat rides and a clear view of the neighboring country — quite a unique sight!
All hotels were clean, comfortable, and well-located. The vehicle provided was well-maintained
Highly recommend this  Prabhu travels  organizer  for anyone looking to explore Northeast India in depth. It’s not an easy region to plan on your own due to remote locations and permits, but with the right people handling logistics, it becomes a smooth and soul-filling journey
Thank you once again to Prabhu Travels for an amazing adventure! 🌄🛶🛕🌿

My overall experience was wonderful.  Starting from Visa preparation to helpful office staff  everything went smoothly. The itinerary was very well designed. We travelled by road, cruise, train. Travelling by overnight cruise twice had different experience. We crossed Baltic Sea and north sea. I feel if you want to explore Europe then you must travel by road and ferry, cruise. And this was included in our tour. We travelled 5 countries. Estonia, a very small country, was also included in this. The heritage walk in Tallin was superb.
And on the top of everything was Norway in nutshell. We could experienced beauty of nature. The journey through mountains, blue river, waterfalls was amazing. I am vegetarian. Still I could get variety of food which was not expected by me. Mango lassi and idali dosa was really unexpected.

Hotels , coaches were comfortable and of best quality. All the things were covered as per shared itenarary and with knowable guides.

Our tour manager Suhas Joshi is very knowledgeable, caring, jolly person. He has taken care of everyone like his family. He provided excellent information about the countries we visited.

Tour was well planned and executed. I was travelling alone but because of excellent group, I never felt lonely and enjoyed my tour safely with lots of lovely memories.

I would recommend Mango holidays to everyone.

Thank you very much.

Then we went to Dubare Elephant Camp. The elephant camp is must visit place. There are around 27 elephants. To visit that camp you need to travel by boat and the ticket booking for the same starts at 4.00 PM.
After completing the Dubare Elephant Camp we came back to resort and we had our dinner.
Next day we relaxed at the resort.
